title: Contract decision: are rollcall status responded/missing arrays optional?
description: Cross-implementation contract divergence on Rollcall Status documents (spec/12-apps.md 18.6.3): Rust RollcallStatus::from_cbor (rust/lichen-client/src/checkin.rs) REQUIRES both responded and missing arrays (invalid_responded_type / invalid_missing_type when absent); the C codec (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1103-1143, documented checkin.h:407-424) treats them as OPTIONAL defaulting to empty. The spec example shows both arrays but never states optionality; no Python oracle exists for 18.6.3 to arbitrate; the only committed status vector carries both arrays so it pins nothing either way. Two plausible contracts: (a) optional-default-empty (C behavior; friendlier for leaders with no responses yet, matches C header docs) or (b) required (Rust behavior; stricter, forces leaders to always emit both). Recommendation: option (a) optional-default-empty - it matches the C reference resource, the checkin.h documentation, and requires no new rejection path; then update Rust to default-empty, document the contract in both headers, and add a vector pinning the omitted-arrays case. Deferred from bead zow8 (its other items are done: u64 id coercion, timeout error-code alignment, Vec caps).
